ResearchCreate.description:
Create a durable questionnaire Research container.

Omitting ``idea_id`` creates or replays a deterministic Project Idea whose
title is the selected ``research_id`` and persists that Idea on the new
Research binding. An exact legacy-ID binding is replayed before a new
revision-bound ID is created only when it already carries the expected
Idea. A historical legacy binding with a null Idea fails closed until the
explicit reconciliation workflow repairs it. Supplying ``idea_id`` retains
exact scoped validation.

idea_id.description: Optional existing Project Idea. When omitted, the service creates or replays a deterministic Idea titled with the selected research_id. An exact existing legacy-ID binding is replayed first only when it already carries the expected Idea; a historical null Idea fails closed until explicit reconciliation.
idea_id.title: Idea Id

title.description: Optional Research name, independent of the provider form title. Omission preserves the stored name on replay.
